exact_symbolic_tail_theorem.limit_and_union_proof: n^(-2) decreases to 0 and sin is continuous at 0, so b(n) decreases to 0; therefore the union over all n>=128 is exactly (0,b(128)]

exact_symbolic_tail_theorem.strict_monotonicity_proof: for n>=128, 0<(n+1)^(-2)<n^(-2)<pi/2 and sin is strictly increasing, hence 0<b(n+1)<b(n)
